response.justification: Despite extensive full-stack and open-source experience, the candidate lacks direct C++ development experience in industrial automation, secure coding per IEC 62443, or cloud-based industrial platform design — core requirements for this role. His C++ exposure is limited to a brief academic/thesis project over a decade ago, with no evidence of recent or professional use in high-performance, multi-threaded, or secure systems.
strengths: Strong full-stack and open-source contributions with diverse tech exposure
Demonstrated leadership in mentoring, workshops, and DevOps infrastructure
Proven ability to deliver complex systems across embedded, web, and IoT domains
concerns: No recent or professional C++ experience in high-performance or industrial systems
Lacks demonstrated knowledge of IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity standards
No experience with message brokers, MQTT, REST in industrial automation contexts
